title: Blackberry B-Pop(B-Burst) Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
description:
Blackberry B-Pop(B-Burst) Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
Blackberry Bliss with Every Puff
Unveil an explosion of flavor with the Blackberry B-Pop(B-Burst) Geek Bar Pulse X 25000. Each draw delivers a burst of rich, juicy blackberry essence, perfectly balanced for a smooth and satisfying vaping experience.
Effortless Vaping Made Simple
Designed for convenience, this sleek disposable vape requires no messy refills or maintenance. Simply unpack, enjoy, and replace when you’re ready. Perfect for those always on the go.
Maximum Puffs, Minimal Hassle
With a remarkable 25,000-puff capacity, the Geek Bar Pulse X keeps up with you through long days and night outs without running out of flavor. Superior longevity, wrapped up in a portable, stylish design.
Key Features
Puff Count
:
Up to 25,000 (Regular Mode) or 15,000 (Pulse Mode)
E-liquid
:
18mL, 5% nicotine
Battery
:
820mAh rechargeable (USB-C)
Display
:
Smart 3D Curved LED Screen
Coils
:
Dual Mesh for superior flavor
Modes
:
Soft, Normal, Pulse
Airflow
:
Adjustable for customized draw
Your Flavorful Companion
Elevate every moment with the Blackberry B-Pop(B-Burst). Whether you’re unwinding after work or catching up with friends, this vape is crafted to enrich your experience with bold, memorable taste.
